title: FuuraikoWiki:Privacy policy
text:
Site information · Privacy policy
This policy explains how FuuraikoWiki handles information when you read or use this personal knowledge wiki. It covers this wiki, not independently operated websites linked from it. Effective date: 20 September 2026. == Reading and server logs == You can read public pages without creating an account. Requests to the web server may be recorded in access and error logs. These records can include your IP address, request time, requested address, response status, browser user agent and referring address. They are used to operate the site, diagnose faults and investigate abuse. Log retention depends on the hosting configuration; this site does not promise a fixed deletion period. == Cookies and browser storage == MediaWiki uses cookies for functions such as login sessions and security. Nord stores your theme, reading text size and sidebar-collapse preferences in your browser's local storage (the keys are nord-theme, nord-text-size, nord-left-collapsed and nord-right-collapsed). You can clear these using your browser's site-data settings; doing so may sign you out or reset preferences. Blocking essential cookies may prevent login or editing. No advertising or third-party analytics integration is configured in the current wiki setup. This does not mean that the web server processes no technical information. == Accounts and contributions == Anonymous editing and public self-registration are currently disabled. Authorized accounts may store a username, password hash, preferences and, if supplied, an email address. Email features are enabled in configuration; delivery depends on the mail service. Saved edits, edit summaries, usernames and revision timestamps are normally public in page histories. Discussion and user pages are also public. Do not submit passwords, private contact details or other confidential information. Deleting visible text does not necessarily remove earlier revisions, logs or backups; access to suppressed information depends on administrator permissions. == External services == Following an external link sends you to another service with its own privacy practices. Embedded or remotely served resources, where used, can also cause requests to their providers. The footer license badge and Moe icon are served locally. Links to the Dashboard, licensing sites and registration sites do not make those services part of this policy. == Requests and changes == For questions, correction requests or privacy concerns, use the contact details linked from the [https://flowing-wind.space/ Flowing Wind Dashboard]. Include the relevant wiki page address, but avoid sending sensitive information unnecessarily. Requests are reviewed in light of technical constraints, public revision records and applicable obligations. This policy may be updated as site practices change; its revision history records changes. See also: [[FuuraikoWiki:About|About]] · [[FuuraikoWiki:Disclaimers|Disclaimers]] · [[FuuraikoWiki:Copyrights|Copyrights]].

title: FuuraikoWiki:Disclaimers
text:
Site information · Disclaimers
FuuraikoWiki contains personally compiled notes and materials shared for learning, discussion and general information. It is not an authoritative reference or a substitute for primary sources and professional advice. == Accuracy and use == Content is provided as available, without a guarantee of completeness, accuracy, currency or fitness for a particular purpose. Notes, translations, calculations, code and examples may contain mistakes or omit assumptions. Verify important claims against original sources, and test examples in an appropriate environment before relying on them. Nothing on this wiki is individualized medical, legal, financial or other professional advice. You are responsible for evaluating information and deciding how to use it. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the site maintainer disclaims liability for loss arising from reliance on the material. This statement does not exclude responsibilities that cannot lawfully be excluded. == Links and third-party material == Links and citations are provided for context and convenience. They do not imply endorsement or control of an external website. Third-party materials retain their own copyright and license terms; their appearance here is not a grant of unrestricted reuse rights. == Corrections == If you find an error, unclear attribution or a rights concern, please contact the maintainer through the contact details linked from the [https://flowing-wind.space/ Dashboard], with the page address and a description of the issue. Corrections may change the current text while earlier revisions remain in history. See also: [[FuuraikoWiki:Copyrights|Copyrights]] · [[FuuraikoWiki:Privacy policy|Privacy policy]].
